description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Imposing Entertainment Taxes by the Kandy Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the imposition and levying of entertainment taxes by a municipal council under the authority of the Entertainment Tax Ordinance and its amended act. It is a regulatory matter that establishes a legal framework for tax collection on specific events, falling squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" classification (Type 5) for new regulations and statutory instruments.
